stemMd: Which inference follows from the researcher's concern?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Observed sales differences may partly reflect unequal visibility created by the platform.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Changing rank always leaves purchases unchanged.

options.label: C
options.textMd: No buyer cares about seller quality.

options.label: D
options.textMd: The ranking has no connection to previous sales.

options.label: E
options.textMd: Every popular seller has an inferior product.

explanationMd: The researcher identifies visibility as a possible contributor to sales. This does not deny other causes of popularity, but it prevents treating observed sales as independent of the display.

distractorRationale.b: That is the hypothesis to investigate, not an established fact.
distractorRationale.c: Visibility effects do not exclude quality preferences.
